traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Identity meets independence and disruption. The urge to be different and to do things your own way. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Difference for its own sake: eccentricity, instability, shocking people to no purpose. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Selfhood and disruption reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Suited to independent or innovative work where you aren't boxed in.
shadow: Egotism and needing to be the center collides with instability for its own sake; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.
